title: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.39251v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trajectory-level GRPO is a common approach for training multi-step GUI agents, but repeatedly rolling out complete trajectories from the task root can be inefficient: task-level rewards provide coarse supervision over which intermediate decisions require improvement, while already-mastered prefixes are repeatedly re-executed before reaching difficult states. We introduce a two-stage adaptive training framework that jointly addresses where to learn and how far to roll out. We first construct reusable intermediate checkpoints from successful expert trajectories and select informative pivots using action disagreement, which measures uncertainty directly from sampled GUI actions. Stage I performs one-step RL at these pivots to improve uncertain local decisions. translated_title: 在哪里学习以及展开多远：面向GUI代理的高效自适应训练
translated_abstract: 轨迹级GRPO是训练多步骤GUI代理的常用方法，但从任务起点反复展开完整轨迹可能效率低下：任务级奖励只能对哪些中间决策需要改进提供粗略监督，而已经掌握的前缀部分在到达困难状态之前会被反复重复执行。我们提出了一个两阶段自适应训练框架，同时解决“在哪里学习”和“展开多远”这两个问题。我们首先从成功的专家轨迹中构建可复用的中间检查点，并利用动作分歧（直接从采样的GUI动作中测量不确定性）来选择信息丰富的枢轴点。阶段I在这些枢轴点执行一步强化学习，以改进不确定的局部决策。阶段II随后根据任务进度，通过自适应的局部、后缀和根节点训练逐步扩展策略的职责范围。可恢复的检查点使重复训练成为可能。
tldr: 提出一种两阶段自适应训练框架，通过从专家轨迹构建可复用的中间检查点、依据动作分歧选取关键枢轴点、并在这些节点上进行一步强化学习与逐步扩展的局部/后缀/根节点训练，显著提升了GUI代理强化学习的训练效率。
en_tdlr: A two-stage adaptive training framework for GUI agents that constructs reusable checkpoints from expert trajectories, applies one-step RL at uncertain action-disagreement pivots, and progressively expands rollout scope through adaptive Local, Suffix, and Root training to improve efficiency.
